def render_readme(content: str, content_type: str) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """Render ``content`` according to ``content_type``.

    Returns a ``(rendered, warnings)`` pair. Unknown media types fall back
    to the plain text renderer, and unsupported charset parameters are
    reported through ``warnings``.
    """
    warnings: list[str] = []
    media_type, params = _parse_content_type(content_type)

    charset = params.get("charset")
    if charset is not None and charset.lower() not in _SUPPORTED_CHARSETS:
        warnings.append(
            f"Unsupported charset {charset!r}; only UTF-8 is supported."
        )

    if media_type == _MARKDOWN:
        rendered = markdown.render(content)
